# letWizard: Buying \| Rental

> LetWizard is India’s best property platform to buy, rent, and list homes. Explore verified listings, smart tools, and even bid on select properties. Perfect for buyers, tenants, and real estate agents.

# Website Base Information

# Services Offered
services:
  - Buy Residential & Commercial Properties
  - Rent Properties (Short-term, Mid-term, Long-term)
  - Property Listing for Sellers & Builders
  - Smart Tools: Buy vs Rent Calculator, Mortgage Estimator
  - Verified Valuations & Market Pricing
  - **Property Bidding Option (Available on Select Properties)**
